title: Midnight Rally: Lantern-Lit Checkpoint Race
description: Michelle stands beside a concept car on a dark nighttime track. The player must place and reposition lanterns along a winding path to illuminate checkpoints, then drive the car through them in order while Michelle acts as the race marshal. Energy is conserved: each lantern draws from a shared fuel pool, and adjusting brightness or repositioning costs fuel, requiring strategic planning with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load Michelle.glb (positioned at the start line, playing an idle animation), CarConcept.glb (drivable vehicle), and Lantern.glb (instantiated up to 6 times as placeable light sources). Scene: a dark flat ground plane (80x80 units) with a winding path marked by 6 checkpoint rings (torus geometries, semi-transparent). The ambient light is very dim (0.05 intensity) so lanterns are essential for visibility. CONSERVATION SYSTEM: A shared fuel pool starts at 100 units. Each lantern placement costs 10 fuel. Each lantern has adjustable brightness (1-5 levels); increasing brightness by 1 costs 3 fuel, decreasing refunds 3. Repositioning a lantern costs 5 fuel. Display fuel as a top HUD bar. INTERACTIONS (10-14 steps): 1) Click ground near a checkpoint to place a lantern (spawns Lantern.glb with a PointLight). 2) Click an existing lantern to select it (highlight with outline). 3) Use mouse wheel on selected lantern to adjust brightness (costs/refunds fuel). 4) Drag a selected lantern to reposition it (costs fuel on drop). 5) Press U for undo, R for redo (full action history stack tracking placement, brightness changes, repositions, and fuel changes). 6) Press SPACE to start the race: car moves forward with arrow key steering (W/A/S/D). 7) Checkpoints only register if illuminated by a nearby lantern (PointLight distance check < 8 units). 8) Michelle plays a cheer animation (or wave if available) when a checkpoint is cleared. 9) If fuel hits 0, no more placements or increases allowed. 10) Complete all 6 checkpoints to win; display elapsed time. Camera: OrbitControls centered on the car during race mode, free orbit during planning phase. Add a mode toggle button: PLAN mode (place/adjust lanterns) vs DRIVE mode (control car). Show checkpoint counter and timer in HUD. Ground uses a dark asphalt-colored MeshStandardMaterial. Each lantern PointLight should cast shadows and use warm orange color (#FF9944).
